'''Umthyg''' was a lackluster [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Umthyg system/Legends|Umthyg system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Agarix Trade Route]] linked it to the [[Dramassia system/Legends|Dramassia system]] as well as the [[Dasoor system/Legends|Dasoor system]] of the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected it to the [[Farstone system/Legends|Farstone system]]. Umthyg was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umthyg was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the [[Planet/Legends|world]] in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
